capabilities: Compose posts and threads in a Bluesky tab
Reply to an existing Bluesky post by pasting its URL
Authenticate with a Bluesky App Password
Generate link preview cards for URLs in posts
extras: README includes a network/privacy section stating it only contacts bsky.social and linked domains, collects no telemetry, and lists planned roadmap features (media, embeds, threads from files).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish posts or threads to Bluesky without leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: This project builds upon the Bluesky AT Protocol, which is licensed under the MIT License.

requires.name: Bluesky account with an App Password

summary: Bluesky posting plugin that composes posts and threads in a tab and replies to existing posts by URL.
